applications.name: Demo app
applications.composeYaml:
services:
  frontend:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    depends_on:
      - backend

  backend:
    image: python:3.12-slim
    command: ["python", "-c", "import time; print('Demo backend service running'); time.sleep(3600)"]
    depends_on:
      - database

  database:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: faultlens_demo
      POSTGRES_USER: demo_user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: demo_password

applications.name: E-Commerce Microservice Architecture
applications.composeYaml:
version: '3.8'

services:
  api-gateway:
    image: envoyproxy/envoy:v1.28-latest
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    depends_on:
      - auth-service
      - order-service
      - catalog-service

  auth-service:
    image: ecom/auth-service:v2.1
    ports:
      - "8081:8081"

  order-service:
    image: ecom/order-service:v3.4
    ports:
      - "8082:8082"

  payment-service:
    image: ecom/payment-service:v1.9
    ports:
      - "8083:8083"

  inventory-service:
    image: ecom/inventory-service:v2.0
    ports:
      - "8084:8084"

  catalog-service:
    image: ecom/catalog-service:v1.5
    ports:
      - "8085:8085"

  notification-service:
    image: ecom/notif-worker:v1.2
    depends_on:
      - postgres-db

  postgres-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"

applications.name: PulseCart
applications.description: A lightweight e-commerce microservice system for testing service dependencies, fault propagation, and automated resilience analysis.
applications.composeYaml:
version: "3.8"

services:
  gateway:
    type: gateway
    port: 8080
    depends_on:
      - auth
      - orders

  auth:
    type: microservice
    port: 8081
    depends_on:
      - users-db

  orders:
    type: microservice
    port: 8082
    depends_on:
      - inventory
      - payments

  inventory:
    type: microservice
    port: 8083

  payments:
    type: microservice
    port: 8084
    depends_on:
      - payments-db

  users-db:
    type: database
    port: 5432

  payments-db:
    type: database
    port: 5433

applications.name: E-Commerce Platform
applications.description: Distributed microservices architecture powering checkout, cart, payment processing, and inventory catalog in an isolated Docker sandbox.

applications.name: CRM & Billing Suite
applications.description: Customer relations and automated billing dispatch platform running containerized worker queues and relational databases.

applications.name: Real-time Event Ingestion
applications.description: High-throughput Kafka and consumer worker cluster validating event streaming resilience under broker network partition.

app-ecommerce.name: API Gateway
app-ecommerce.description: Public ingress reverse-proxy routing client requests with rate limiting and TLS termination.

app-ecommerce.name: Auth Service
app-ecommerce.description: Handles JWT verification, session caching, and RBAC token rotation.

app-ecommerce.name: Order Service
app-ecommerce.description: Coordinates cart checkout, order validation, and transaction orchestrations.

app-ecommerce.name: Payment Service
app-ecommerce.description: Manages third-party payment tokens, gateway routing, and ledger authorization.

app-ecommerce.name: Inventory Service
app-ecommerce.description: Real-time stock deduction, SKU warehouse reservation, and item lock management.

app-ecommerce.name: Product Catalog
app-ecommerce.description: Read-heavy product search, category browsing, and pricing catalog.

app-ecommerce.name: Notification Service
app-ecommerce.description: Asynchronous transactional email, SMS receipt, and push notification dispatcher.

app-ecommerce.name: Database (PostgreSQL)
app-ecommerce.description: Primary relational database storing transactional orders, users, and audit records.
